annotations.title: Create, rename or delete a Shopify blog

description: Create a new blog on the brand's Shopify store (title, optional handle and commentPolicy), rename one or change its handle or comment setting (update; redirect:true keeps old links working when the handle changes), or DELETE one. Deleting a blog PERMANENTLY deletes every article in it and Shopify keeps no trash: call delete WITHOUT confirm first, which changes nothing and says which blog and how many articles would go; show the user, and call again with confirm:true only once they agree. Every answer is read back from Shopify. Free. list_shopify_blogs lists the blogs; post_to_shopify_blog writes articles into them.

blog.description: update / delete: the blog id, handle or title (list_shopify_blogs)

commentPolicy.description: comments published at once, held for approval, or off

confirm.description: delete: true only after the user saw what goes with it

handle.description: the end of the blog URL (made from the title when omitted on create)

redirect.description: update: redirect the old handle to the new one

title.description: create (required) / update: the blog title, up to 255 characters

name: manage_shopify_blog
